title: OdeCare — Elderly Monitoring Without Cameras or Wearables
excerpt: Elderly monitoring without cameras: OdeCare learns your parent’s usual routine and lets you know when something needs your attention. No wearables either.
content_html:
Remote care for ageing parents

Stay close, even from afar

OdeCare learns your parent’s usual routine and lets you know when something needs your attention. No cameras, microphones or wearables.

01 — Sense

One sensor in each room

Radar sensors go in the bedroom, bathroom, kitchen and hallway. Each sensor detects presence and movement in its room. Together, they show whether the day is going as usual.

Nothing to wear, charge or remember. Installation takes about 15 minutes.

All is well

Sleep7 h 40 min · as usual

Morning activityon time

Kitchen visits3

02 — Learn

See whether the day is going as usual

Within a few days, OdeCare learns your parent’s usual routine: when they wake up, move around the home, visit the kitchen and go to bed.

The app gives you a clear overview without treating every late morning as an emergency.

Worth a call

A sharp movement was detected in the bathroom, followed by 10 minutes without movement.

Call nowEverything is fine

03 — Alert

Get an alert when something needs attention

OdeCare checks for small changes quietly in the background. You hear from it only when there is a clear reason to check in.

How it works

What OdeCare is made of

OdeCare uses room sensors, door and climate sensors, a home hub and the family app. The hub processes activity inside the home. Your phone receives only status updates and alerts.

Radar sensors

One in each room. They detect presence and movement without a camera or microphone. Nothing to charge.

Door and climate sensors

They detect doors opening, movement and changes in temperature.

The home hub

It connects the sensors and processes their data locally. If power or internet is lost, the app tells you immediately.

Your phone

It shows how the day is going and alerts you when your parent may need a call.

No video. No audio.

Designed around their privacy

One sensor on the wall.
Nothing else changes.

The sensor sits quietly on the wall, like a smoke detector. It does not record video or sound, and your parent does not need to do anything.

Buy OdeCare

Is OdeCare watching my parent?

No. OdeCare devices have no cameras or microphones.

Radar sensors detect presence and movement through reflected radio waves. The app receives simple information about activity and routine — never video or audio.

There are no recordings because nothing is recorded.

What happens if the internet or power goes down?

OdeCare tells you when the home hub loses its internet connection or power.

The app will show that the system is offline until the connection is restored.

My parent does not want another gadget

They do not need to wear, charge, press or learn anything.

The sensors stay on the wall and work in the background. Their daily routine does not need to change.

Is OdeCare a medical device?

No. OdeCare does not diagnose medical conditions, replace professional care or contact emergency services automatically.

It detects presence, movement, extended inactivity and changes in routine, then shares that information with the family.

How is the price calculated?

The price depends on the size of the home because each main room needs its own radar sensor.

  • $590 for a one-bedroom home
  • $690 for a two-bedroom home
  • $790 for a three-bedroom home

Every package includes the complete sensor kit, professional installation and the first 3 months of service.

Before payment, a specialist confirms the home layout, the exact equipment and the final price.

What happens after the first 3 months?

The service continues for $29 per month.

This includes home monitoring, alerts, the family app and customer support. You can cancel the subscription at any time. The equipment remains yours.

For families who want to stay close

Their routine stays the same.
You know when something changes.

Buy the complete kit

First 3 months of service included · 30-day return

家居中心

它连接传感器并在本地处理其数据。 如果断电或断网，应用程序会立即通知您。

你的电话

Is OdeCare watching my parent?

不会。OdeCare 设备没有摄像头或麦克风。

雷达传感器通过反射的无线电波检测存在和运动。 该应用程序接收有关活动和日常事务的简单信息，而不是视频或音频。

没有录音，因为没有记录任何内容。

What happens if the internet or power goes down?

当家庭集线器失去互联网连接或电源时，OdeCare 会告诉您。

该应用程序将显示系统处于离线状态，直到连接恢复。

My parent does not want another gadget

他们不需要佩戴、充电、按压或学习任何东西。

传感器安装在墙上并在后台工作。 他们的日常生活不需要改变。

不会。OdeCare 不会自动诊断医疗状况、替代专业护理或联系紧急服务。
